parser_bugs: camel_violation() startsDigit dead branch: CAMEL_OK=^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*$ makes 'if not CAMEL_OK.match -> return special' fire BEFORE 'if ids[0].isdigit() -> startsDigit' is ever reached, so any digit-leading idShort would be misclassified as 'special'. ZERO data impact here: independently confirmed all 929 camel violations across the 6 files are 'underscore' type and no idShort starts with a digit, so the dead branch is never exercised.

is_cd_ref() is over-broad: it treats EVERY (ExternalReference, GlobalReference) terminal key as a CD reference. Consequence: IDTA submodel-template semanticIds on Submodel roots (admin-shell.io/idta/HierarchicalStructures/1/1/Submodel; admin-shell.io/idta/sm/workstationworkermatchingdata) get bucketed into dangling['external'] as if they were missing ConceptDescriptions. The COUNT is computed correctly per this criterion (external=1 each for MODEL_A/B/C and wwm), but the label 'dangling CD' is semantically wrong for these template refs.

Dangling detection only follows semanticId chains. It NEVER inspects the actual reference payloads: ReferenceElement.value, RelationshipElement.first/second, and qualifier-level semanticIds are not checked for CD resolution. For this dataset this blind spot has no effect on the reported semanticId-dangling COUNTS (verified by brute-force whole-subtree diff), but it does cause genuine malformed/dangling payloads to go uncaught (see missed_findings).
false_positives: dangling['external'] for MODEL_A/MODEL_B/MODEL_C = 'https://admin-shell.io/idta/HierarchicalStructures/1/1/Submodel' on the HierarchicalStructures Submodel root. This is a valid IDTA submodel-template semanticId (ExternalReference/GlobalReference type=GlobalReference), NOT a missing ConceptDescription. Counted correctly but mislabeled as a dangling CD by the over-broad is_cd_ref.

dangling['external'] for wwm = 'https://admin-shell.io/idta/sm/workstationworkermatchingdata' on the WorkstationWorkerMatchingData Submodel root. Same nature: valid submodel-template semanticId, not a dangling CD. (The only genuinely dangling external entries are psm/psm_smt's 'https://example.com/ids/cd/0445_8041_5062_7858' placeholder, which is a legitimate flag.)

verifyPart1.scope: Code review of mod_run/_audit_all_aas.py judgment logic (Part-1 deterministic audit), verified against all 13 AAS sources (6 JSON + 7 SMT .aasx) and the produced _aas_full_audit.json.
parser_bugs: dangling check has NO `mt != 'Submodel'` guard (line 287, vs the sem_missing check at line 284 which DOES guard Submodel). Combined with is_cd_ref accepting any ExternalReference->GlobalReference, every Submodel whose semanticId is a standard IDTA submodel-template URL is misclassified as a dangling CD reference. Confirmed false positives: MODEL_A/B/C HierarchicalStructures -> https://admin-shell.io/idta/HierarchicalStructures/1/1/Submodel; wwm WorkstationWorkerMatchingData -> .../idta/sm/workstationworkermatchingdata; all 7 equipment DigitalNameplate (a Submodel) -> .../idta/nameplate/3/0/Nameplate. FIX: add `mt != 'Submodel'` to line 287, or in is_cd_ref reject GlobalReference values ending in '/Submodel' / matching admin-shell.io submodel-template URLs.

is_cd_ref (line 172-176) treats EVERY ExternalReference->GlobalReference as a concept-description reference. That is true for this project's own CDs (smart-factory.kr/ids/cd/...) but also sweeps in (a) submodel-template refs on Submodel/SMC nodes and (b) external dictionary IRDIs like '0173-1#01-AHD205#004' (ECLASS) and admin-shell.io/vdi/2770/.../EntityForDocumentation. These are intentional external classifications, not authoring defects, yet they land in dangling['external'] as if broken. FIX: classify admin-shell.io / IRDI (regex ^\d{4}-\d#) targets as 'intentional-external' bucket, separate from genuine project-CD dangling. NOTE this is a SEPARATE fix from the Submodel guard: the guard removes Nameplate/HierarchicalStructures (Submodel nodes) but NOT the IRDIs (which sit on Property/SMC nodes).

Global-union dangling basis (lines 246-251, 287) masks within-environment dangling: a reference in file X resolves if ANY of the 13 files defines that CD id. Measured 66 references that resolve ONLY cross-file. Most significant: psm_smt's `cd/CycleTime/1/0` (14x) and `cd/DepPrev/1/0` (15x) do not exist in psm_smt's own CDs and resolve only because ScreenPrinter.aasx happens to define CycleTime and MODEL_A/B/C define DepPrev. This exactly hides the CycleTime-vs-CycleTimeSec naming-mismatch the task flagged. MODEL_C masks 26x cd/RatedPowerKw. FIX: report BOTH per-file dangling (resolve against own CDs only) and cross-file-resolved delta; treat cross-file-only resolution as a warning, since the project contract is each AAS is a standalone input.

dangling/sem_missing/cd-incomplete checks read ONLY node.get('semanticId'). They never inspect ReferenceElement.value, RelationshipElement.first/second, or Qualifier.semanticId. Consequence: project-CD references carried by ReferenceElement.value are NOT counted as dangling. Confirmed missed REAL project dangling: MODEL_A cd/P30500003 (1x); psm_smt's Materials Operation in/output refs -> cd/PCB, cd/SolderPastedPCB, cd/SolderCream, cd/ChipMountedPCB, cd/ReflowedPCB, cd/GoodPCB, cd/DefectPCB (7 distinct, all genuinely undefined). So the headline project-dangling counts are an UNDERCOUNT. (psm/psm_smt also carry 255 ModelReference->Property and 1 ModelReference->Submodel in ReferenceElement.value; is_cd_ref correctly does NOT treat ModelReference->Property/Submodel as CD refs, so those are fine to skip as CD-dangling -- but the GlobalReference cd/ URLs above should be checked.)

cd_incomplete (lines 217-235) treats missing IEC 61360 `dataType` as a hard incompleteness reason, dominating the counts (MODEL_A: 133 of 159 incomplete CDs are dataType-only). dataType has optional cardinality in IEC 61360 and is meaningless for CDs describing structural/part concepts. Evidence: PCB_03203204 has full preferredName + definition + sourceOfDefinition but no dataType, and is a well-formed part CD. RECOMMEND: split severity -- HARD = missing embeddedDataSpec / dataSpecificationContent / preferredName; SOFT (advisory) = missing dataType, missing definition. Do not let dataType inflate the incomplete-CD headline.
false_positives: dangling['external'] entries that are standard submodel-template semanticIds on Submodel nodes: MODEL_A/B/C HierarchicalStructures (.../HierarchicalStructures/1/1/Submodel), wwm WorkstationWorkerMatchingData (.../sm/workstationworkermatchingdata), all 7 equipment DigitalNameplate (.../nameplate/3/0/Nameplate). Not CD references at all -> not dangling CDs.

dangling['external'] entries that are external dictionary classifications, intentionally not in our CD union: ECLASS IRDIs 0173-1#01-AHD205#004 (all 7 equipment, on GuidelineSpecificProperties), 0173-1#01-AHX837#002 (AOI), 0173-1#01-AHF578#003 (AOI), and admin-shell.io/vdi/2770/1/0/EntityForDocumentation (ScreenPrinter/Mounter/Reflow). These are correct external references, not authoring errors.

cd_incomplete count is inflated: in MODEL_A 133/159 incomplete CDs are flagged solely for missing dataType, which is optional and inapplicable to structural/part CDs (e.g. PCB_03203204 is otherwise complete).
missed_findings: Real project-CD dangling references carried by ReferenceElement.value are NOT detected because the audit only walks semanticId: MODEL_A cd/P30500003; psm_smt cd/PCB, cd/SolderPastedPCB, cd/SolderCream, cd/ChipMountedPCB, cd/ReflowedPCB, cd/GoodPCB, cd/DefectPCB (the Materials Operation material-flow targets). These are genuine undefined CDs and the audit's project-dangling totals undercount them.

Within-environment dangling masked by the global union: psm_smt cd/CycleTime (14x, resolves only via ScreenPrinter.aasx) and cd/DepPrev (15x, resolves only via MODEL_A/B/C); MODEL_C cd/RatedPowerKw (26x). These should be surfaced because each AAS is contractually a standalone input, and they confirm the CycleTime/CycleTimeSec and RatedPower/RatedPowerKw naming-mismatch hypotheses from the task brief.

Latent (not triggered on this data, count = 0): is_sml_child = (parent_mt == 'SubmodelElementList') is direct-child-only, whereas 'SML 하위' most naturally reads as SML *descendants*. No current violation has an SML ancestor beyond its direct parent, so the divergence is academic here -- but if a future AAS nests SMC/Entity inside an SML, that SMC's own children would be CamelCase/idShort-checked despite living under an SML. If descendant-exclusion is the true intent, track an ancestor flag instead of parent_mt.
verifyPart1.notes: Concern-by-concern: (1) NOT correct -- the audit does not 'exclude' non-CD references; it never even inspects ReferenceElement.value / Relationship.first-second / Qualifier.semanticId (so it misses real dangling there), AND it fails to exclude Submodel-template refs from the semanticId path (missing `mt != 'Submodel'` guard + over-broad is_cd_ref). ModelReference->Property/Submodel in ReferenceElement.value are correctly NOT treated as CD refs, so that specific exclusion is fine. (2) Over-detects: dataType-missing should be SOFT, not hard; hard = preferredName/embeddedDataSpec/content. (3) Global union is too forgiving -- 66 cross-file-masked refs, including the task's own CycleTime/DepPrev/RatedPowerKw cases; report per-file + cross-file delta. (4) idShort/CamelCase SML-child exclusion is implemented as direct-child only; intent ('하위'=descendants) is broader but the divergence is zero on current data. Priority of fixes: A) split dangling into project-genuine / submodel-template / external-dictionary buckets and add the Submodel guard (kills the bulk of false 'external dangling'); B) extend the reference walk to ReferenceElement.value / Relationship to catch the real missed material-CD dangling; C) add per-file dangling alongside global; D) demote dataType to soft. SEPARATE-USER-DECISION (do not decide silently): ~726 HasPart_*/PCB_*/MODEL_*_* underscore idShorts in MODEL_A/B/C are flagged as CamelCase 'underscore' violations, but the underscores encode part numbers / model identity in HierarchicalStructures Entity ids. 설비 nameplate 미완성: 7개 설비 중 Loader 만 DigitalNameplate/Identification/Technical>GeneralInformation 에 실제 모델명 SLD-120 와 자산URL(/ids/asset/Loader/SLD-120) 이 채워져 있고, 나머지 6개(ScreenPrinter/SPI/Mounter/AOI/Reflow/Unloader)는 IDTA 템플릿 placeholder 그대로 — ManufacturerProductType='FM-ABC-1234', URIOfTheProduct='https://www.domain-abc.com/Model-Nr-1234/Serial-Nr-5678'. 따라서 psm_smt 가 가정한 모델명이 6개 설비에 데이터로 존재하지 않아 자산참조 6/7 이 깨짐.

CycleTime vs CycleTimeSec 네이밍 불일치: psm_smt 설비공정 CycleTime RE 는 cd/CycleTime/1/0 사용. 그러나 MODEL_A/B/C·psm·psm_smt 의 공정 사이클타임 표준 CD 는 cd/CycleTimeSec/1/0. 설비 측 CycleTime CD(cd/CycleTime/...)는 ScreenPrinter 1대에만 존재(그나마 본래 버전은 v2/0, v1/0 는 부수적). 6개 설비엔 CycleTime SME 부재. 사이클타임 자동 lookup 설계가 6/7 설비에서 성립 안 함.

RatedPowerKw vs RatedPower CD 불일치: psm_smt RatedPowerKw RE 는 cd/RatedPowerKw/1/0 (self-ref) 인데 7개 설비는 전력을 cd/RatedPower/1/0(idShort RatedPower) 및 cd/PowerConsumption/{1,2}/0 으로 노출. semanticId 가 다르므로 'catalog AAS 의 같은 semanticId Property 자동 lookup' 의도가 전혀 성립하지 않음. 또한 cd/RatedPowerKw/1/0 은 psm_smt 안에서 ×2 중복 정의(Part-1 진단과 일치).

CycleTime·RatedPowerKw ReferenceElement 가 trivial self-reference (value 의 GlobalReference 가 자신의 semanticId CD 와 동일). 설비의 구체 값(Property)을 가리키지 않으므로 ReferenceElement 가 실제 lookup 타깃을 지정하지 못함 — value 가 설비 SME 경로/구체 인스턴스를 가리키도록 재설계 필요.

SMT 물질흐름 자원 CD 전면 부재: cd/PCB/1/0, SolderPastedPCB, ChipMountedPCB, ReflowedPCB, SolderCream, GoodPCB, DefectPCB 7종이 psm_smt 외 어디에도 정의 안 됨. Materials Operation 의 input/output 가 이 CD 들로 공정간 물질흐름(직전 output==다음 input)을 표현하지만 CD 정의가 없어 round-trip 불가. (양품/불량 분기는 AOI output 의 GoodPCB/DefectPCB 두 변수로 표현.)

버전 불일치: 설비 측 실데이터 CD 는 대부분 /2/0 버전(예 cd/CycleTime/2/0, cd/PowerConsumption/2/0)인데 psm_smt 참조는 /1/0. 설비-시뮬 간 CD 버전 정책이 어긋남.

proposals.content: cd/PCB/1/0, cd/SolderCream/1/0, cd/SolderPastedPCB/1/0, cd/ChipMountedPCB/1/0, cd/ReflowedPCB/1/0, cd/GoodPCB/1/0, cd/DefectPCB/1/0 (자원), cd/Materials/1/0(Operation), cd/n_modules/1/0, cd/SMTProcess/1/0, cd/SMTLines/1/0, cd/Line_1/1/0, cd/Line_2/1/0, cd/SMTMaterials/1/0, cd/MODEL_A|B|C/1/0 (구조 컨테이너) ConceptDescription 추가. 각 description 에 산출/물질흐름 규칙 명시.

proposals.content: cd/CycleTime/1/0 → cd/CycleTimeSec/1/0 으로 변경(모델·psm 표준과 통일). 설비에서 값을 끌어올 경우엔 설비 측 CycleTime CD 버전(ScreenPrinter cd/CycleTime/2/0)과의 매핑을 별도 명시.

proposals.item: RatedPowerKw → 설비 RatedPower 정렬 및 중복 제거
proposals.content: 두 가지 중 택1: (a) 설비 값을 자동 lookup 하려면 RE.semanticId 를 설비가 쓰는 cd/RatedPower/1/0 (또는 cd/PowerConsumption) 으로 맞추고 RE.value 를 해당 설비 SME 경로로 지정; (b) 시뮬 자체 파라미터로 둘 거면 self-ref 를 유지하되 설비 lookup 의도를 description 에서 삭제. 더불어 psm_smt 내 cd/RatedPowerKw/1/0 중복 정의(×2) 1개 제거.
proposals.rationale: 현재 RatedPowerKw self-ref 는 설비의 실제 전력값을 전혀 가리키지 못하면서 description 은 'catalog 자동 lookup' 이라 주장 — 의도와 데이터가 불일치. 중복 CD 는 Part-1 진단에서도 지적됨.

proposals.item: 설비공정 자산참조를 globalAssetId 형식으로 정정 + 6개 설비 nameplate 채우기
proposals.location: psm_smt SMTProcess.*.<설비>Process semanticId (14개) 및 SMT/{2_SPI..7_Unloader} nameplate
proposals.content: 두 트랙 동시: (1) psm_smt 자산URL 을 설비 globalAssetId 형식 'https://www.smart-factory.kr/ids/asset/<Fac>/1/0' (=설비의 /ids/aas/<Fac>/1/0 와 매칭되도록) 로 통일하거나, 모델명 키로 묶을 거면 설비 DigitalNameplate/URIOfTheProduct 를 진실의 원천으로 고정. (2) ScreenPrinter/SPI/Mounter/AOI/Reflow/Unloader 6개 설비의 DigitalNameplate(URIOfTheProduct, ManufacturerProductType, OrderCodeOfManufacturer 등) placeholder('FM-ABC-1234','domain-abc.com/...')를 실제 모델명(HS-520S, KY-8030, M-Series, BF-Comet-c, GT-R8, SUD-120)으로 교체.
proposals.rationale: 현재 7개 설비참조 중 Loader 만 해소되고 그것도 globalAssetId 가 아닌 URIOfTheProduct 경로로만 매칭. 6개 설비는 모델명 데이터 자체가 placeholder 라 어떤 형식을 써도 매칭 불가. 자산 식별 키(globalAssetId vs URIOfTheProduct) 를 하나로 못박고 설비 데이터를 실제 값으로 채워야 SMT 라인↔설비 결선이 성립.

propose.summary: SMTProcess(psm_smt) 일관성 분석 + 제안. 1단계 참조해소를 소스에서 전수 재검증해 정정·심화함. 핵심 정정: (1) psm_smt 자체 conceptDescriptions 에는 SMTProcess 서브트리가 쓰는 CD 가 거의 정의돼 있지 않다 — 오직 CycleTimeSec/1/0(×1)·RatedPowerKw/1/0(×2 중복)뿐. CycleTime/1/0(설비공정 14개가 CycleTime RE 의 semanticId 로 사용)은 psm_smt·models·psm 어디에도 없고 오직 ScreenPrinter 설비에만 우연히 존재 → psm_smt 안에서 dangling ref. 즉 'CycleTime vs CycleTimeSec' 는 단순 네이밍차가 아니라 dangling reference 이며, rename CycleTime→CycleTimeSec 한 번으로 dangling 해소 + 모델 ProcessNode 스키마 정렬을 동시에 달성. (2) RatedPowerKw 는 반대 — CD 는 psm_smt(중복)·models 에 정의돼 해소되나 RE 의 value 가 자기 CD 를 가리키는 self-ref placeholder. (3) [중심 설계 결정] 설비공정의 CycleTime/RatedPowerKw 는 description 상 'catalog(설비) AAS 의 같은 semanticId Property 자동 lookup' 설계(Option 1)지만, 7개 설비 전부 RatedPower value=None·CycleTime value=None(ScreenPrinter)·6/7 설비 nameplate 가 placeholder(FM-ABC-1234) 라 lookup 이 무엇도 해소하지 못함 → 현재 데이터로 시뮬 비실행. 반면 CycleTimeSec/RatedPowerKw CD 가 psm_smt 에 이미 미사용 상태로 존재하고 모델 ManufacturingProcess 노드가 동일 CD 를 value 보유 Property(CycleTimeSec=xs:int s, RatedPowerKw=xs:double kW)로 쓰는 선례가 있으므로, ReferenceElement→값 보유 Property 전환(Option 2, 신규 CD 0개) 을 권고. Option 1 채택 시엔 7개 설비파일 값 채움 + 설비 RatedPower→RatedPowerKw 네이밍/단위 정렬 + align_asset_id 가 모두 선행돼야 함. Option 2 채택 시 두 RE 의 '자동 lookup' description 은 거짓이 되므로 description 갱신이 제안의 필수 일부. elements.meaning: Root Submodel that provides one or more 3D model files (or links to them) plus meta information about them. Attached to the AAS of the asset the 3D models describe.
elements.usage: Aim: support search, integration and usage of 3D models. Contains exactly one child SML 'Model3D'. Parent = the Asset Administration Shell to which the 3D models are associated.

elements.meaning: Ordered list whose entries (each an SMC) are individual 3D model entities. Each entry groups one model's File / Capability / Geometry info.
elements.usage: One [nn] SMC per 3D model variant/file. Each SMC entry contains File [1], Capability [0..1], Geometry [0..1].

elements.meaning: Information about the model file entity itself: the 3D model file (or an external link to it), plus source/consuming-application meta, versions, preview, classification. Adapts SMT IDTA 02004-1-2 Handover Documentation structure, extended for 3D.
elements.usage: Mandatory in every Model3D entry. Its rich internal tree (FileId, FileVersion holding DigitalFile/PreviewFile/ExternalFile, FileClassification, ConsumingApplication, SourceApplication, Api, HostOrganization, ProvidingOrganisation, VendorOrganisation, FileFormat, etc., pp.20-65) is out of scope for this Capability/Geometry-focused catalog; treated here as a single entry.

elements.meaning: Describes what can and what should NOT be done with the model: how 'trustworthy' it is, whether elements were removed (IP/computation), whether geometry is measured vs designed, and the model's lifecycle/maturity state.
elements.usage: Optional collection. Children: PosModelPurpose[1], NegModelPurpose[0..1], EmbeddedInfo[0..1], State[0..1], ObjectType[0..1], Origin[1], Simplification[0..1].

elements.meaning: List of purposes for which the model is explicitly NOT suitable (e.g. 'Rendering').
elements.usage: Optional. Entries are Property[String] from ValueList ModelPurpose. Counterpart to PosModelPurpose.

elements.meaning: List of further information embedded inside the 3D model file itself (e.g. 'Reference Points').
elements.usage: Optional. Entries are Property[String] from ValueList EmbeddedInfo (PMI / ReferencePoints / Kinematics / Parametrization). NOTE: Table 65 idShort cell prints 'Embedded Info' with a space, but the semanticId and summary use 'EmbeddedInfo' (no space) — canonical idShort is EmbeddedInfo; the space is a spec typo.

Children: Description[0..1] (Prop[String], free text of what was simplified), ReducedElements[0..1] (SML of Prop[String], from ValueList ReducedElements: ScrewJoints / InnerParts / Graphics), DerivedFrom[0..1] (Reference [Ref] pointing to the reference Model3D).

elements.usage: Optional. Entries are Property[String] from ValueList ReducedElements (ScrewJoints / InnerParts / Graphics).

elements.usage: Optional reference. Establishes the lineage that gives Description/ReducedElements their meaning.

elements.meaning: Basic set of geometric information (representation kind, length unit, bounding box(es), reference system(s)) describing the model. Explicitly complements but must NOT redefine the 3D model files (§2.2.4 intro, p76).
elements.usage: Optional collection. Direct children are exactly 4: Representation[1], LengthUnit[1], CartBoundingBox[0..1], CartRefSystem[0..1]. (CartOffsetVector / NormOrientationVector are NOT direct children of Geometry — they appear under each CartRefSystem; CartBoundingVector appears only under CartBoundingBox.)

elements.meaning: Geometric representation kind of the asset (e.g. 'Wire Frame').
elements.usage: Mandatory single Property. Value from ValueList Representation (SolidBody / WireFrame / Surface / Mesh / PointCloud — per Fig 108).

elements.meaning: Measurement unit (e.g. 'mm') of all length properties within the subordinate Properties of this Geometry SMC (i.e. the unit for the X/Y/Z values of the vectors).
elements.usage: Mandatory single Property. Governs the unit of the CartOffsetVector / CartBoundingVector / NormOrientationVector X/Y/Z Double values (whose tables say 'Always state the unit').

elements.meaning: List of cartesian bounding box(es) of the asset. Each [nn] SMC entry describes one bounding box.
elements.usage: Optional list (0..* entries when present). Each entry SMC contains: BoundingBoxKind[1], CartRefSystem[0..1] (the box's own reference frame), CartBoundingVector[1] (the box extent).

elements.meaning: Kind of bounding box (e.g. 'MaxEnvelope').
elements.usage: Mandatory single Property per box entry. Value from ValueList BoundingBoxKind (MinEnvelope / MaxEnvelope — per Fig 108).

elements.meaning: The single cartesian reference system (origin + orientation) IN WHICH THIS BOUNDING BOX is defined. CartBoundingVector's expansion is measured from this frame (Table 87 explanation).
elements.usage: Optional, at most one per box. modelType is SMC (a SINGLE frame), NOT an SML — this is the key distinction from the Geometry-direct CartRefSystem. Children: CartOffsetVector[0..1], NormOrientationVector[3-as-listed-in-Table78 / canonically 1 SML of 3 SMCs].

elements.meaning: Cartesian offset vector (origin position) of the box reference system.
elements.usage: Optional. Children X[1], Y[1], Z[1], each Property[Double] (component of the offset vector; always state the unit).

elements.meaning: The three cartesian norm (orientation) vectors of the box reference system (one SMC per axis, each with X/Y/Z Property[Double]).
elements.usage: Mandatory when the box CartRefSystem is present. DISCREPANCY: the parent Table 78 lists it as '[SMC]' card '3'; Table 83 + Fig 91 clarify it is one [SML] containing 3 SMCs (card 1 in parent, the '3' = inner SMC count). Use [SML][SMC].

elements.meaning: Cartesian vector describing the EXPANSION (extent) of the bounding box, measured FROM the box's cartesian reference system (CartRefSystem). This is the direct evidence that the box CartRefSystem defines the box's origin/orientation.
elements.usage: Mandatory per box entry. Children X[1], Y[1], Z[1], each Property[Double] (component of the bounding vector; always state the unit). Exists ONLY under CartBoundingBox — has no counterpart under the Geometry-direct CartRefSystem.

elements.meaning: List of cartesian reference system(s) of the asset/model ITSELF (independent of any bounding box). Each [nn] SMC entry is one reference frame.
elements.usage: Optional. modelType is SML (a LIST of frames), NOT SMC — key distinction from the box CartRefSystem. Each entry SMC contains: CartOffsetVector[0..1], NormOrientationVector[1 (SML of 3)].

elements.meaning: Cartesian offset vector (origin position) of a model/asset reference system. Distinct from the box CartOffsetVector (different semanticId/parent).
elements.usage: Optional. Children X[1], Y[1], Z[1], each Property[Double] (component of the reference vector; always state the unit).

elements.meaning: The three norm (orientation) vectors of a model/asset reference system (one SMC per axis, each X/Y/Z Property[Double]). Distinct from the box NormOrientationVector (different semanticId/parent).
elements.usage: Mandatory when the model CartRefSystem entry is present. Each of the 3 SMC entries holds X[1],Y[1],Z[1] Property[Double].

elements.path: (ValueLists, non-modeled) ModelPurpose / ObjectType / Origin / State / EmbeddedInfo / Representation / BoundingBoxKind / ReducedElements
elements.modelType: ValueList (predefined values, NOT part of the SM instance)
elements.meaning: Predefined enumerated value sets the corresponding Properties should draw from. ModelPurpose=Logistics/SimuMesh/VirtualCommissioning/3DPrintingSlicer/Rendering; ObjectType=Component/Assembly; Origin=MeasureOptical/MeasureMechanical/DesignEngineering/DesignGenerative; State=Prototype/PreRun/InSeries/InterIn/InterOut; EmbeddedInfo=PMI/ReferencePoints/Kinematics/Parametrization; Representation=SolidBody/WireFrame/Surface/Mesh/PointCloud; BoundingBoxKind=MinEnvelope/MaxEnvelope; ReducedElements=ScrewJoints/InnerParts/Graphics.

catalog.cartRefSystem_explained:
CartRefSystem appears in TWO distinct locations with DIFFERENT semanticIds, parents, modelTypes and roles — they are NOT redundant.

(i) GEOMETRY-DIRECT CartRefSystem — Table 91 (p94), Figure 99.
  semanticId: https://admin-shell.io/idta/Models3D/Model3D/Geometry/CartRefSystem/1/0
  Parent: Geometry. modelType: SubmodelElementList [SML] of SMC. Cardinality in Geometry: 0..1.
  Explanation text: 'List of cartesian reference system.' (Table 73 calls it 'List of three cartesian reference systems of the asset.')
  ROLE: defines reference frame(s) OF THE MODEL / ASSET ITSELF — the coordinate system(s) in which the 3D model is expressed, independent of any bounding box. Because it is an SML it can hold MULTIPLE reference frames (each entry an SMC with CartOffsetVector[0..1] + NormOrientationVector).

(ii) BOUNDING-BOX CartRefSystem — Table 78 (p81), Figure 86.
  semanticId: https://admin-shell.io/idta/Models3D/Model3D/Geometry/CartBoundingBox/CartRefSystem/1/0
  Parent: CartBoundingBox (one entry of the CartBoundingBox SML). modelType: SubmodelElementCollection [SMC]. Cardinality in the box: 0..1.
  Explanation text: 'Cartesian reference system of the cart bounding box of the Asset.'
  ROLE: defines the SINGLE coordinate frame IN WHICH THAT BOUNDING BOX IS DEFINED. It is an SMC (exactly one frame), with the same internal shape (CartOffsetVector[0..1] + NormOrientationVector).

WHY THEY ARE DIFFERENT (decisive evidence):
1. Different semanticId — .../Geometry/CartRefSystem/1/0 vs .../Geometry/CartBoundingBox/CartRefSystem/1/0. In AAS these are different concepts.
2. Different parent — Geometry vs CartBoundingBox.
3. Different modelType — SML (a LIST of model/asset frames, Table 91 Class = 'SubmodelElementList [SML] that contains SubmodelElementCollections') vs SMC (a SINGLE box frame, Table 78 Class = 'SubmodelElementCollection [SMC]'). This list-vs-single asymmetry is visible in the UML too: Figure 81 shows 'CartRefSystem : SML [0..1]' directly under Geometry, while Figure 84 shows 'CartRefSystem : SMC [0..1]' inside the CartBoundingBox SMC.
4. Different role — (i) is the model's/asset's own coordinate system(s); (ii) is the frame that a particular bounding box is expressed in.

RELATIONSHIP (not a duplicate, a deliberate layering):
The box CartRefSystem gives the box its own origin and orientation; CartBoundingVector (Table 87) 'describes the expansion of the bounding box FROM a cartesian reference system (CartRefSystem)' — i.e. the box extent is measured from the box's CartRefSystem. The Geometry-direct CartRefSystem instead anchors the whole model/asset. A consumer can therefore place a bounding box in its own local frame (ii) and separately know the model's global frame(s) (i); the two frames may coincide or differ, but the spec models them separately so a box never has to be re-expressed in the model frame, and the model can declare reference frames even when no bounding box is provided. This matches §2.2.4's stated intent that Geometry complements (never redefines) the 3D model. Both reference systems share an identical inner structure (CartOffsetVector with X/Y/Z [Double], and NormOrientationVector as an SML of three axis SMCs each with X/Y/Z [Double]); only their semanticId, parent and SML-vs-SMC multiplicity differ.

remove.reason: Whole subtree removable. Capability describes model trustworthiness/purpose/lifecycle/origin/simplification (PosModelPurpose[1], NegModelPurpose, EmbeddedInfo, State, ObjectType, Origin[1], Simplification). None is consumed by a viewer that just loads a mesh. IDTA-safe except it contains two [1] children (PosModelPurpose, Origin) — removing the whole [0..1] Capability is conformance-safe; you only break strict conformance if you keep Capability but drop its mandatory children.

Whole subtree removable for pure viewer loading. Geometry holds Representation[1], LengthUnit[1], CartBoundingBox[0..1], CartRefSystem[0..1] — bounding-box extents, length units and reference frames exist for collision/extent/space-planning and precise placement, i.e. exactly the 기하 연산(충돌·정밀좌표) the task excludes. A glTF/STEP file already carries its own units and geometry, so the viewer reads them from the file, not from these SMEs. Removing the [0..1] Geometry is IDTA-conformance-safe.

proposal.cartRefSystem_resolution: Not a duplication — the two CartRefSystems are semantically distinct, and BOTH are removable for the current visualization purpose. (1) Geometry > CartRefSystem (SML [0..1], one or more SMC entries each with CartOffsetVector + NormOrientationVector X/Y/Z) = the MODEL's reference frame: where/how the whole model is placed (origin offset + orientation) in a parent coordinate system. (2) Geometry > CartBoundingBox > CartRefSystem (SMC, single, same CartOffsetVector + NormOrientationVector children) = the BOUNDING BOX's own frame: where that extent box sits. They describe different objects (the model vs. its bounding box), so neither is a redundant copy of the other. Resolution: the box-nested CartRefSystem is removed together with its parent CartBoundingBox as collision/extent data (purpose-excluded — task excludes 충돌·정밀좌표). The Geometry-direct CartRefSystem is the only KEEP candidate, and only if the viewer needs to position the 7 machines into a shared SMT-line layout from AAS-supplied offsets/orientations. For the face-value reading the task gives ('3D 모델은 뷰어 로딩에만, 기하 연산 안 함' → single-model loading), there is no precise-placement need, so drop the Geometry-direct CartRefSystem too — and with no vectors retained, LengthUnit (which only governs those X/Y/Z values) and Representation lose their consumers, so the entire Geometry SMC is removed. Net: remove both CartRefSystems (whole Geometry). Keep the Geometry-direct one ONLY if shared multi-machine placement is later required; the box-nested one is removed in all cases.
proposal.minimal_structure:
A viewer needs almost nothing beyond a file pointer + format. Minimal structure:

Models3D (SM)
└ Model3D (SML)
   └ [entry SMC]  (×7, semanticId = .../cd/<Fac>Model3D/1/0  ← the only model→equipment link)
      └ File (SMC)
         └ FileVersion (SML→SMC)
            ├ DigitalFile (File)   ← value = file pointer (path/URL in the .aasx package), contentType = real 3D MIME (model/gltf-binary | model/step | ...). MUST replace the copied image/png placeholder when populated.
            └ PreviewFile (File)   ← OPTIONAL: image/png thumbnail for the viewer UI; drop if no thumbnail wanted.

That is the whole tree. DigitalFile alone (a File element carrying both pointer and format) covers 'load and render'; the entry's semanticId already says which of the 7 machines it is. Everything else in the IDTA template is removed: the entire Capability and Geometry SMCs, and within File — FileId, FileClassification, ConsumingApplication, SourceApplication, ProvidingOrganization, ExternalFile/Api/HostOrganization, FileFormat (redundant with contentType), BasedOn/RefersTo, and the Title/FileName/FileVersionId/StatusValue/SetDate version metadata. Node count drops from 116 → ~5 per entry (Model3D entry / File / FileVersion / DigitalFile / PreviewFile). The 98 Models3D-namespaced conceptDescriptions should be pruned to only those backing the retained semanticIds.

Strict-IDTA caveat: this minimal form drops several IDTA-mandatory [1] elements (Capability.PosModelPurpose[1], Capability.Origin[1], Geometry.Representation[1], Geometry.LengthUnit[1], and File-internal mandatory fields). It is therefore a project-specific reduction, not an IDTA-conformant ProvisionOf3DModels submodel. If conformance must be retained, keep the [1] elements with placeholder values and remove only the [0..1] subtrees (NegModelPurpose, EmbeddedInfo, State, ObjectType, Simplification, CartBoundingBox, CartRefSystem, ExternalFile, etc.).

CORE FINDING: The removal proposal is conformance-unsafe for the File subtree because it keeps File and FileVersion as DigitalFile containers while deleting ~10 of their mandatory [1] children. The cleanest fix is consistency with the proposal's own approach for Capability/Geometry: do NOT keep File+FileVersion as a stripped shell. If only the file pointer is wanted, the conformance-safe minimum is File[1]{FileId[1], FileClassification[1], FileVersion[0..1]{PreviewFile[1], FileFormat[1], ProvidingOrganization[1], Title[1], FileName[1], FileVersionId[1], StatusValue[1], SetDate[1], DigitalFile[0..1]}} — i.e. DigitalFile is the optional one, PreviewFile is mandatory, and FileId/FileClassification are mandatory siblings of FileVersion. A viewer-only minimization cannot be made strictly IDTA-conformant by sub-element pruning while keeping File; it can only be done by dropping whole optional containers.

- File SMC: FileId SML[1], FileVersion SML[0..1], ConsumingApplication SML[0..1], FileClassification SML[1].
